newsitem.title: USA: Envirogen to buy Fluid Management.
newsitem.headline: Envirogen to buy Fluid Management.

text.p: Envirogen Inc said on Wednesday it entered into a letter of intent to buy Wisconsin-based Fluid Management Inc for about $11 million in cash and about 4.2 million common Envirogen shares.
Fluid Management is an environmental consulting and engineering firm that reported gross sales in 1995 of $21.4 million and pretax income of $4.6 million.
E.M. Warburg, Pincus & Co has expressed an interest in providing capital to finance the acquisition and supplement working capital, Envirogen said.
If the deal went through, Warburg would buy about $16 million of Envirogen stock at a price of $2.625, it said.

Shares issued in connection with the acquisition and the private placement would have the benefit of certain registration rights, but would be restricted from public resale for a period of one year from the date of closing, the company said.
The acquisition was subject to certain conditions, including due diligence investigation, obtaining financing, and satisfactory operating results by both companies.
